name: Tokidomi ~Rikashitsu de Mattete~
original_name: ときドミ〜理科室で待ってて〜
source:
Main character has a crush with a boy. He enters the same high school and joins the same science lab to get closer. What kind of science will they develop? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角暗恋着一个男孩。为了接近他，她进入同一所高中，并加入同一个理科实验室。她们会发展出怎样的科学？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
